title: Bound Windows snapshot concurrency, label process columns correctly and resolve trusted macOS symlinks.
changes: Keep Windows computer_snapshot probes at two concurrent PowerShell processes so the snapshot completes within the relay timeout on loaded hosts.
Report Windows list_processes rows under the matching name,pid,session,mem header.
Keep the managed Windows startup and update handoff hidden, and repair a stale launcher even when the canonical packages are already current.
Resolve trusted parent symlinks in unrestricted mode so macOS /tmp and /var paths work with delete, move and copy, while symbolic-link leaves remain rejected.
